items.title: Switch — SoundCloud + YouTube upload package
items.summary: Approving this queues the Switch instrumental (ISΛRK × 10k.emraan, 186 bpm, C min, drill) for manual upload to SoundCloud and YouTube, scheduled to go public on 2026-07-18. The package includes: metadata, upload description, pre-upload checklist, social captions for Instagram/X and YouTube community post, and an art direction prompt for cover/thumbnail production. No files are published automatically — all uploads and posts are manual steps listed in checklist.md.
